verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents Composition Revisions to "manage changes to Compositions with revisions," which is native versioning for its function-pipeline automations. Its CLI can render and test Composition Functions offline, which supports pre-apply review, and it builds, updates and pushes versioned packages. Community users note the declarative YAML is easy to commit to source control for GitOps, though that git workflow is user-side and earns no credit. missing for 10: explicit documented rollback to a prior revision, a documented review/approval workflow, and hands-on corroboration of revision-based rollback.
